attributes.name: Brain Ooze
attributes.powers:
The Brain Ooze is immune to the Mental and Poison traits. All damage dealt by the Brain Ooze is Electricity damage.

The difficulty of the check to defeat the Brain Ooze is increased by the adventure deck number of a random monster from the box.

If undefeated, discard a spell.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Brain Ooze, replace "Before you act, draw a monster from the box; the Brain Ooze’s difficulty to defeat is increased by that monster’s adventure deck number" with "The difficulty of the check to defeat the Brain Ooze is increased by the adventure deck number of a random monster from the box".
corrections.issue: The Brain Ooze tells you to "draw" a monster from the box to increase the difficulty. Am I really supposed to put that monster in my hand?
